changes.evidence: He is already a student at Xavier's school in X-Men (2000) (Storm's class, the fireball Bobby freezes). The X-Men stage is keyed to X2, but the same student status that puts him in the X-Men in X2 holds from X-Men (2000); he only leaves for Magneto at Alkali Lake in X2.

In season 2 (episode 18, S2E9) she only teams up with Captain Carter against Strange Supreme, and the Watcher returns her home. She joins Carter's new Guardians of the Multiverse in season 3: the team (Carter, Kahhori, Byrdie, Storm) is first shown in S3E7 (episode 25), saving Earth-625 from the cosmic squid.

The S1 Guardians end in S1E9 when the Watcher sends everyone home. In S2E9 (episode 18) she works with Kahhori against Strange Supreme and the Watcher returns her to her world; no Guardians team exists in season 2. She forms the new Guardians of the Multiverse (Kahhori, Byrdie, Storm) 'sometime after parting ways with the Watcher', first shown in S3E7 (episode 25). Only the last stage's title changes, S2 to S3.

Stages are out of story order: the list puts him in the Hellfire Club before Nazi Germany. In First Class he is Dr. Klaus Schmidt working for the Nazis at Auschwitz in 1944, and founds the Hellfire Club afterwards (1950s Las Vegas club, leader by 1962). The leading Hellfire Club stage claims a membership before 1944 that never happens; the last stage is unchanged.

Stages are out of story order: Weapon X is listed first, before the U.S. Army. In Origins Victor fights in the Army through the wars, then joins Stryker's Team X, then works for Stryker's Weapon X program hunting former Team X members, and finally walks away (Independent). The last stage and the left title are unchanged.

Stages are out of story order: the leading Weapon X stage puts him in Weapon X before Team X. In Origins Wade Wilson is a Team X mercenary first, and only later does Stryker turn him into Weapon XI. The last stage is unchanged.

Stages are out of story order: the leading Yashida Corporation stage comes before the Imperial Japanese Army. He is an IJA soldier at Nagasaki in 1945 and only founds the Yashida Corporation in 1953. The last stage is unchanged.

owner_calls.question: Are T:fox-sabretooth (X-Men 2000, Deadpool & Wolverine; Tyler Mane) and T:fox-victor-creed (X-Men Origins: Wolverine; Liev Schreiber) the same person, so one duplicates the other?
options: Keep two records (different actors, continuity never confirms them)
Merge into one Victor Creed / Sabretooth record
owner_calls.evidence: The X-Men Movies wiki treats them as one character: its Sabretooth page (born Victor Creed) lists Tyler Mane for X-Men and Deadpool & Wolverine and Liev Schreiber for Origins, with Team X, Weapon X and the Brotherhood all under one original-timeline affiliation. The app's D&W step calls the Void one a variant.

owner_calls.question: The Sentinels record (Earth-10005) mixes the dark-future Sentinels of Days of Future Past with Trask's 1973 prototypes and the confiscated Sentinels in X-Men: Apocalypse, which by the owner's rule are Earth-TRN414. Split, or keep one record?
options: Split: future Sentinels Earth-10005, 1973 and Apocalypse Sentinels Earth-TRN414
owner_calls.evidence: DOFP's 1973 steps (Magneto hijacks the prototypes, the program is shut down) and the Apocalypse step (Hank and Raven train against confiscated Sentinels in 1983) happen in the revised timeline. Only younger selves get their own TRN414 records, so the rule does not settle a group of machines. T:fox-bolivar-trask (another chunk) has the same split.

owner_calls.question: Earth for the Logan film (T:fox-x-24 and T:fox-zander-rice here, and every other Logan record): keep Earth-10005, or use Marvel Database's Earth-17315?
options: Keep Earth-10005 (Deadpool & Wolverine ties Logan's death to Deadpool's Earth-10005)
owner_calls.evidence: The owner's Fox rule lists the films before DOFP, the TRN414 films and the Deadpool films, but not Logan. Marvel Database files Logan's characters as Earth-17315 (X-24 (Earth-17315), Zander Rice (Earth-17315) exist; no Earth-10005 pages). The app files every Logan character at Earth-10005.

owner_calls.question: Gamora is 'Guardians of the Multiverse (from the start)', but her story-first step (episode 13, S2E4) is before the Watcher recruits her (episode 9, S1E9). Stage the prequel episode separately?
options: [["Independent","What If...? S2"],["Guardians of the Multiverse","What If...? S1"]]
owner_calls.evidence: In S2E4 Thanos sends her to kill Tony on Sakaar; she turns on the Grandmaster with him and later kills Thanos. Uatu recruits her into the Guardians only in S1E9, which aired first but happens later in her story.
